Who We Are
Hi! We’re AntiSocial, a social-first digital marketing agency powered by people who love to create. Our work spans industries and disciplines, from conceptual campaigns and strategic media plans to creator partnerships, influencer strategies, and content production for leading brands around the world. As part of the Thinkingbox family, we bring creativity, collaboration, and innovation to everything we do. At AntiSocial, you’ll join a diverse and talented team that delivers bold campaigns and innovative solutions for some of the world’s top brands. Our culture is one of collaboration, creativity, and connection. Whether it’s brainstorming with colleagues, hanging out with our office dogs, or enjoying monthly events, we keep our work environment vibrant, inclusive, and fun.
The Opportunity
We are looking for an Executive Creative Director (ECD) to lead the creative vision of AntiSocial. As Executive Creative Director, you’ll be the senior creative leader for AntiSocial, responsible for setting the creative standard and ensuring our work is ambitious, culturally relevant, strategically sharp, and built for the way people actually consume content.

You’ll lead and inspire our creative team, partner closely with Strategy, Accounts, Social, Production, and senior leadership, and play a key role in both our existing client relationships and new business.

This role requires someone who understands big brand ideas but is equally passionate about social. You know that great creative today can be a major integrated campaign, a TikTok idea, a creator collaboration, a reactive cultural moment, or an always-on content platform – and you know how to build teams that can deliver across all of it.

Creative Leadership & Vision

• Set and champion the overall creative vision and standard for AntiSocial.
• Lead creative across major accounts, campaigns, pitches, and new business opportunities.
• Push teams toward work that is distinctive, culturally relevant, strategically grounded, and effective.
• Ensure ideas translate naturally across social platforms while having the potential to extend into broader integrated campaigns and experiences.
• Stay deeply connected to culture, emerging platforms, creators, technology, and changing audience behaviours.
• Build a creative culture where experimentation, curiosity, collaboration, and ambitious thinking are encouraged.

Team Leadership

• Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary creative team across copy, art direction, design, content, and social creative.
• Provide clear, constructive creative direction while giving teams the space and confidence to develop their own ideas.
• Help define the structure, capabilities, and talent AntiSocial needs as the company continues to grow.
• Identify opportunities to strengthen the team through hiring, development, freelance talent, and external creative partners.
• Foster an inclusive, collaborative environment where people can do the strongest work of their careers.

Clients & New Business

• Act as a senior creative partner to key clients, building trust and confidently presenting and defending creative thinking.
• Translate client and business challenges into compelling creative opportunities.
• Partner with Strategy and Account leadership to develop strong creative briefs and ensure strategic thinking carries through to execution.
• Play a leadership role in pitches and new business, helping shape the creative story and representing AntiSocial in the room.
• Build relationships that position AntiSocial as a trusted creative partner rather than simply an executional social agency.

Creative Excellence & Execution

• Oversee work from initial brief and concept through production and final delivery.
• Partner closely with Production to ensure ambitious ideas are executed at a high level while remaining realistic about budgets, timelines, and platforms.
• Balance brand-building creativity with the speed, volume, and responsiveness required by social.
• Raise the quality of both large campaign work and everyday content – understanding that every touchpoint contributes to the brand.
• Know when to push for craft and polish and when speed, relevance, and authenticity matter more.

• Significant creative leadership experience within an advertising, creative, social, or integrated agency environment.
• Proven experience at the Creative Director, Group Creative Director, Executive Creative Director, or equivalent level.
• A portfolio of standout creative work across social, digital, content, and integrated campaigns.
• Deep understanding of social platforms and how creative behaviour differs across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and emerging channels.
• Strong conceptual thinking with the ability to move between big campaign ideas and fast, culturally relevant social content.
• Experience leading and developing multidisciplinary creative teams.
• Strong presentation skills and the ability to sell ambitious creative thinking to senior clients and stakeholders.
• Experience leading pitches and contributing to new business growth.
• A strong understanding of production and the ability to guide ideas from concept through execution.
• An active interest in culture, creators, entertainment, technology, design, and the constantly evolving social landscape.

• Monday - Thursday in office (Fridays are remote optional)

• Consistent culture and team-building events
• Employee recognition and incentive programs
• Seasonal celebrations and gatherings throughout the year
• Office lunches
• Branded company swag
• Access to industry events, learning opportunities, and non-profit outreaches
• Dog-friendly offices

OpenAI Finance helps ensure the organisation is positioned for long-term success as we pursue our mission. The Strategic Sourcing & Procurement team helps OpenAI scale responsibly and at speed by choosing the right external partners, structuring strong commercial agreements and building resilient supplier relationships. Professional Services provides specialist expertise and capacity across OpenAI, spanning consulting and advisory, finance and accounting, legal, people-related services and managed services. About the Role

We are seeking a Strategic Sourcing Leader to lead and develop the Professional Services sourcing team and set direction across its portfolio. This is a people-management role with accountability for team performance, commercial quality, stakeholder experience and sustained business outcomes. You will translate business priorities into category strategies, achievable delivery plans and clear decision authority, while developing the judgement and independence of experienced sourcing professionals.

You will oversee a broad portfolio, from strategic advisory relationships and enterprise programmes to a high volume of statements of work and renewals. You will remain hands-on in selected complex negotiations and critical decisions, while enabling the team to own and deliver its work. Working with senior leaders across Finance, Accounting, Legal, People, Extended Workforce and the business, you will create clarity from incomplete information, resolve competing priorities and adapt the team's approach as OpenAI grows.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

- Lead and develop the team: set clear objectives and expectations, delegate with appropriate decision boundaries, provide regular feedback, review performance and address persistent gaps. Build development and coverage plans that strengthen capability and reduce reliance on individual experts.

- Set the Professional Services portfolio strategy and roadmap, connecting business objectives, demand, spend, supplier markets and risk. Guide category plans and decisions on where to compete, consolidate, retain specialist partners or change the service delivery model.

- Manage the team's pipeline and capacity across strategic negotiations, supplier governance and recurring SOWs. Allocate work by capability, complexity and risk; make resource constraints and dependencies visible; and agree priorities and recovery plans before commitments become unachievable.

- Personally lead selected critical negotiations and set standards for commercial quality across the team. Review strategy and assumptions early, using credible alternatives and comparable economics to shape scope, resource mix, pricing, deliverables, acceptance criteria, change controls, audit rights and exit protections.

- Build proportionate intake, tiering, preferred-partner models, playbooks and review pathways with Procurement Operations, Contract Management, Enablement and control functions. Agree decision rights and usable handovers so repeatable work moves efficiently and material exceptions receive the right attention.

- Strengthen supplier relationships and accountability through segmentation, competition, performance reviews and improvement plans. Agree post-signature owners with the business and use service evidence, concentration risk, renewal exposure and transition options to guide supplier decisions. Assess supplier productivity proposals for their effect on staffing, fees, quality and delivery risk.

- Partner with Finance and Accounting on spend visibility, demand scenarios, forecasting, approval discipline and invoice-to-contract alignment. Test fee models, staffing assumptions, change exposure and total economics, with clear baselines for savings, cost avoidance and realized value.

- Partner with Legal, People and Extended Workforce to select appropriate service models and distinguish Professional Services from contingent labour or hiring needs. Translate specialist guidance into practical safeguards for service delivery, intellectual property, confidentiality and workforce-related risk.

- Establish a concise view of portfolio and team performance covering commercial and service outcomes, pipeline health, cycle time, risk, stakeholder experience and team capability. Use evidence to improve decisions, commitments and delivery; distinguish negotiated benefits from value realized.

- Build trusted senior stakeholder relationships and challenge demand, scope or supplier preferences constructively. Resolve difficult trade-offs on value, speed, quality and risk, and escalate decisions beyond your authority with clear options and a recommendation.

- Personally use approved AI tools and lead adoption of improved sourcing workflows across the team, including supplier research, proposal analysis, negotiation preparation and reporting. Validate sources and calculations, retain human commercial judgement, and measure adoption and gains in quality, speed or capacity.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have 10+ years of progressive strategic sourcing, procurement or category management experience, with substantial depth across multiple Professional Services categories and ownership from strategy through supplier performance.

- Bring 5+ years of people leadership experience, including formal responsibility for objectives, performance, development and delegation. Can demonstrate stronger team capability, independent judgement and sustained delivery through your leadership.

- Have personally led complex services negotiations and can explain the alternatives, commercial decisions and measurable outcomes, while showing how you coach others to deliver comparable quality.

- Understand consulting, advisory, managed services and project-based commercial models, including experience with large multidisciplinary firms such as the Big Four and specialist providers. Bring breadth across areas such as finance, accounting, legal, healthcare or benefits-related services, alongside sound judgement on workforce boundaries.

- Have turned category strategies into practical operating improvements, balancing standardization with flexibility and strategic work with recurring demand. Can show adoption, reliable delivery and stronger stakeholder experience.

- Influence senior stakeholders through trust, structured thinking and concise communication. Can work through disagreement, make trade-offs explicit and seek decisions at the right level.

- Bring strong financial and analytical judgement, using imperfect spend, supplier and performance data to compare options, test assumptions and verify business value beyond negotiated savings.

- Lead effectively through ambiguity, rapid change and limited structure. Can reset priorities, invite challenge and adapt working practices to different company stages, operating models and organisational cultures.

- Have practical experience using AI to redesign sourcing work and helping others adopt it, with clear human review, quality checks and evidence of improvement.

jobs.description:
회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

조직 소개

Coupang Ads는 세계 최고 수준의 광고 솔루션을 제공하는 조직을 지향합니다. Coupang Ads는 광고주가 매출 증대, 시장 점유율 증가, 신규 고객 확보 및 브랜드 자산 구축과 같은 마케팅 목표를 달성할 수 있도록 돕습니다. 우리의 솔루션은 광고주의 니즈를 반영하며, 광고주의 규모와는 상관없이 그들의 비즈니스 성장을 돕기 위해 기획합니다. Coupang Ads는 Sales, Marketing, Video Product, Operations, Product, Engineering 팀과 같은 다기능적이고 협업적인 팀들로 구성되어 있습니다.

우리는 각자의 분야에서 전문가이며 항상 광고주를 우리가 하는 모든 일의 중심에 둡니다. 우리는 제품과 서비스에 열정을 가지고 있으며 이는 우리가 하는 일의 가치를 높여 줍니다. Coupang Ads 구성원들은 Coupang Ads를 일하기 좋은 곳으로 만드는데 큰 역할을 하며, 우리는 빠르게 변화하는 역동적인 환경에서 일하고 싶어하는 다양한 배경을 가진 사람들을 고용하고 개발하며, 각 직원이 존중과 권한을 부여 받고 지원받는다고 느낄 수 있는 환경을 만들어갑니다. 이런 환경과 사람들은 광고주를 대신하여 혁신적인 관점을 제공할 수 있습니다. 우리는 고객중심의 생각, 끈기, 사려 깊음, 그리고 신속한 행동을 직접 보여줄 수 있는 자질을 중요하게 생각합니다.

우리의 목표는 세계 최고의 광고 팀에서 일하기에 가장 좋은 장소를 만드는 것입니다. 혁신적이고 역동적인 환경에서 업계를 선도하고, 팀과 함께 성장을 달성하고자 하는 열정적인 분이라면 Coupang Ads와 함께하세요.

Coupang Ads에서 여러분은 세계에서 가장 가치 있고 가장 빠르게 성장하는 광고 솔루션 중 하나를 제공하게 될 것입니다.

직무 소개

Ads Acquisition Support 팀은 쿠팡 광고를 이용 중이거나 광고 활용이 필요한 다양한 판매자의 성장을 지원하는 팀으로, 광고 컨설팅, 운영 가이드 및 문의 대응을 통해 광고 성과 향상을 돕고 있습니다.

여러 카테고리의 판매자와 소통하며 상황에 맞는 광고 솔루션을 제안하고, 이커머스 및 디지털 광고 비즈니스에 대한 이해를 넓혀 나갑니다. 또한 데이터 기반의 컨설팅과 커뮤니케이션 경험을 통해 광고 세일즈에 필요한 역량을 쌓고 판매자의 비즈니스 성장을 가까이에서 경험할 수 있습니다. 디지털 광고와 세일즈 분야에서 커리어를 시작하는 분들에게는 광고 세일즈의 기본기를 익히고 전문성을 키워갈 수 있는 좋은 출발점이 되며, 정규직 전환 기회가 열려 있어 업무 성과와 역량을 바탕으로 쿠팡 내에서 장기적인 커리어를 만들어 갈 수 있습니다.

업무 내용

• 쿠팡애즈 (광고사업부) 아웃바운드 마케팅
• 쿠팡 광고를 사용 중인 광고주 인큐베이션 (광고영업 및 최적화 가이드)
• 쿠팡 광고를 사용 중이지 않은 판매자 광고 컨설팅 및 문의지원

자격 요건

• 학사 이상의 학위를 보유하신 분
• 전문지식을 기반으로 한 설득 커뮤니케이션이 가능하신 분
• 능동적 아웃바운드 전화 업무에 익숙하신 분
• 이커머스/디지털 광고에 대한 이해도가 있으신 분
• 중급 이상 스킬의 엑셀을 활용한 업무 경험이 있으신 분

우대 사항

• 세일즈 직무 경험이 있으신 분
• 텔레마케팅 관련 직무 경험이 있으신 분

기타안내

• 연봉: 3,230만원
• 근무지: 전일 재택근무 (입사 후 1개월간은 사무실 근무 병행-서울 광진구 구의 본사)
• 고용형태: 쿠팡 본사 소속 계약직, 최초 계약기간 6개월
• 참고사항: 6개월 단위 계약 연장 검토, 12개월 재직 시 근무 성과에 따라 정규직 전환 검토

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

전형절차

• 서류전형(리크루터 스크리닝콜) - 직무 적합성 인터뷰 - 핵심 역량 인터뷰 - 최종 합격
• 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
• 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

참고사항

• 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
• 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
• 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
• 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
• 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
• 고용형태는 계약직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

• 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/

서류 반환 정책

• 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
• 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.

Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

WHY THIS ROLE?

North is Cohere's cutting-edge AI workspace platform, designed to revolutionize the way enterprises utilize AI. It offers a secure and customizable environment, allowing companies to deploy AI while maintaining control over sensitive data. North integrates seamlessly with existing workflows, providing a trusted platform that connects AI agents with workplace tools and applications.

Some of our most important work is making the agents and AI-powered experiences inside North genuinely useful in the workflows customers rely on every day. These systems become valuable when users can build with them, steer them, inspect their work, recover from errors, and trust them to complete messy tasks inside real enterprise environments.

This role is about making those AI experiences reliable, useful, and production-ready. You’ll work with product engineering, modelling and design to turn model capability into reliable, user-facing systems: agent builders, eval frameworks, proactive intelligence, and new interfaces for collaborating with AI. Sometimes that means shipping a new product surface, sometimes a better eval or feedback loop, sometimes prompt and context experiments, and sometimes redesigning the workflow so the model is being asked to do the right thing.

AS AN APPLIED AI ENGINEER, AGENTS & AUTOMATIONS, YOU WILL:

- Build AI-powered product experiences that help users create, configure, evaluate, and improve workflows across North.

- Design and ship new interfaces for interacting with models, including workflow builders, proactive assistants, review flows, and other human-AI collaboration patterns.

- Build eval, observability, and feedback systems that measure whether AI experiences succeed in real enterprise workflows.

- Improve AI reliability through product design, prompting, context construction, tool-use strategies, instrumentation, and feedback loops.

- Turn production failures, user feedback, and real-task data into better product behavior, stronger eval suites, regression tests, and signals for modelling.

- Work closely with modelling, product, design, customer teams, and domain experts to define what “good” means for specific workflows and ship measurable improvements.

- Help decide when a workflow needs a more constrained product experience, a better model interface, a stronger eval, or a deeper modelling investment.

Example problems you might work on include helping users build AI automations from natural language, creating evals for multi-step agent workflows, adding proactive intelligence inside the product, or creating interfaces that make agent behavior easier to inspect, steer, and trust.

YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF:

- You have shipped LLM-powered, agent-powered, or AI-assisted product experiences into production, and improved them based on real-world feedback.

- You are a strong software engineer who enjoys working across backend systems, user-facing product, data, evals, and model behavior.

- You think in terms of user outcomes and system behavior, not just model metrics.

- You have strong product taste and care about how the interface, workflow, and model work together to help users succeed.

- You enjoy debugging messy real-world failures and turning what you learn from production, user testing, and evals into durable improvements.

- You enjoy owning ambiguous problems end-to-end and working across system boundaries to ship something genuinely useful.

FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

- A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

- Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

- RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

- 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

- Annual enrichment benefits:

Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

- 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

- Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

- Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

- For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

- For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

- Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic runs some of the largest AI training and inference workloads in the world, across multiple hardware platforms. We work from the chip level up with our silicon partners, and we are now deepening that investment by building a custom silicon team.

You will be one of a small number of people covering a large surface. We are opening searches across the key domains below, and we are interested in candidates whose center of gravity sits in any of them:

• Front-end design
• Pre-silicon verification
• Physical design
• Design for test
• Analog and mixed-signal
• Technology and foundry
• CAD and design infrastructure
• Packaging, signal integrity, and power integrity

This is a role for someone who has shipped silicon, has a realistic relationship with schedules, and is comfortable making consequential calls without a large organization behind them.

Key responsibilities

• Take part in end to end activities for the program: strategy, specification, execution and the technical bar.
• Write the specifications and interface definitions that others design against and keep them coherent as the architecture converges
• Make and own directional calls: technology and IP selection, where we build versus buy versus license, and where we take design authority versus rely on partners
• Build and share AI-assisted approaches to the code-like parts of your domain, and help the team learn what Claude can genuinely accelerate
• Contribute to the architecture and micro-architecture discussion from your domain's perspective, including the tradeoffs your area imposes on the rest of the chip
• Partner with Anthropic's inference, performance, kernels, and infrastructure teams on hardware-software co-design, and with our hardware systems team on bring-up and integration
• Support first-silicon bring-up and debug when it arrives, regardless of which domain you came in through

Minimum qualifications

• Deep, hands-on expertise in at least one silicon domain: front-end design, pre-silicon verification, physical design, design for test, analog and mixed-signal, technology and foundry, design infrastructure, or packaging and signal/power integrity
• Direct personal contribution to silicon that taped out and shipped, with ownership you can speak to in detail
• Working fluency in the domains adjacent to your own, sufficient to reason about chip-level tradeoffs outside your specialty
• Experience working with external partners — ASIC houses, IP vendors, foundries, or test partners — including reviewing their work and holding a technical bar
• Track record of owning directional technical decisions and their consequences, not only making recommendations
• Practical experience using AI coding tools in your own work, and clear ideas about where they help and where they do not
• Clear written and verbal communication, and experience driving alignment across teams and organizations
• Comfort operating with high autonomy and little scaffolding on a highly dynamic program

Preferred qualifications

• Experience on machine learning accelerators, high-performance compute, or other large, high-bandwidth designs
• Experience on a founding or early-stage silicon team, including standing up flows, methodology, or tooling from nothing
• Experience with both partner-executed and fully in-house programs, and a view on the tradeoffs between them
• Familiarity with the chip-package-system interface and the tradeoffs that cross it
• Experience with hardware-software co-design and working directly with compiler, kernel, or runtime teams
• Experience building or extending AI-assisted design, verification, or physical design flows
• Depth in memory subsystems, on-die interconnect, numerics, or low-power design

Representative projects

• Writing the specification for a compute datapath and defending its numeric format strategy against the alternatives
• Standing up front-end flows and release management from scratch, then handing releases to an ASIC partner on a fixed cadence
• Running fast in-house place-and-route loops on a critical block and feeding PPA reality back into the architecture
• Selecting and qualifying PHY IP, then validating it on first silicon
• Building a formal verification methodology for a new block and deciding where formal earns its keep versus simulation
• Defining test strategy and the automated-test-equipment handoff interface with our partner
• Prototyping a Claude-assisted workflow for RTL review, coverage triage, or specification consistency checking, and reporting honestly on what it did and did not do
• Debugging a first-silicon failure that crosses your domain and someone else's

In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
